subject: Strategic ISV privatelisting, metering SKU & co-sell tags
messages:
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@edgeware.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner listing & co-sell: Edgeware/Redwood next steps

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Edgeware AI is excited to pursue a Privatelisting + co-sell path with Redwood — we think the combined runtime + our data connector will sell well into some of our joint target accounts. Before we lock dates with our sales teams we need to confirm a few technical and commercial points so we can scope the listing properly: 

- Metering model: how will SKUs map if we offer a bundled private-offer (hourly runtime + per-embedding)? We need a sample mapping for finance.
- Privatelisting eligibility: any blockers for Gov/regional controls (we will need Azure GovCo in one account).
- Evidence: we can share our SOC 2 report next week; what evidence do you need from Redwood for co-sell?
- Demo dates: can you run a joint technical demo + pricing walk-through week of 6/29? Prefer 6/30 afternoon PT.

Also attaching a short architecture diagram to show where our agent connector sits (cc: attachment). Happy to take a quick call to triage.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Partnerships
Edgeware AI
[Attachment: edgeware_arch_diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@edgeware.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner listing & co-sell: Edgeware/Redwood next steps

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We want to move quickly on this. High-level answers and a proposed next step below: 

- Metering / SKUs: Redwood can publish a paired SKU model (runtime hours + embeddings). I attached our marketplace checklist which includes an example mapping table — we can adapt it to your pricing.
- Privatelisting: Azure GovCo is supported on the Private listing path; there are a couple of consent items for the contract and an additional security attestation (I’ll list them for the team).
- Evidence: For co-sell we typically need a short technical evidence packet (1 pager), SOC 2 summary, and at least one joint demo recording. If you can share SOC 2 next week that’s ideal.
- Demo: 6/30 2:00pm PT works for me. Can you confirm? We’ll invite Sales Engineering and Product.

Next step: workshop 6/30 at 2pm PT to align SKUs, finalize Privatelisting eligibility, and review the SOW. I’m looping Ben and Vivek to coordinate SKU entitlement and commercial playbook.

Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-marketplace-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jun 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Partner listing & co-sell: Edgeware/Redwood next steps

Internal note — quick alignment before the 6/30 workshop: 

- Metering mapping: suggest three candidate SKU mappings we can propose to Edgeware: (A) bundled hour + embedding discount, (B) runtime-only with resell embedding add-on, (C) entitlement-based seat credit for early POC. I’ll put those options into the attached template.
- Commercial incentives: recommend 3 months demo credits (up to $15k) to help close the first joint pilot — approve?
- Security evidence: request Edgeware’s SOC 2 and a data flow diagram for Azure GovCo review. For our side, we should surface a short one-page SSO/KMS attestation and network topology doc. Olga — can you prepare the attestation and a short checklist for Privatelisting compliance?

If we agree on the demo credits and the SKU mapping approach I’ll draft the commercial paragraph for the SOW.

Ben
Director, Partner GTM
[Attachment: metering_mapping_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
